answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 26237 Country: India Title: I want to ask is "GARARA" compulsory for ghusl? Question: Us salamu alaikum wr wb, I want to ask is "GARARA" compulsory for ghusl. Jazak Allah Answer ID: 26237 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2375/H=880/th=1431) Gargling is necessary in the fardh ghusl. However, it is not necessary in the state of fasting rather only rinsing mouth is enough. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
